originality.rationale: The first full three-spin path-entropy cumulant-generating function is a Perron eigenvalue of a tilted irreversible generator, which is not supplied by primary predecessors determining Gibbs marginals and un-tilted one- and two-time correlations. Relevant published-finding corpus searches found different dynamics/observables, not a covering exact three-site tilted formula. Residual priority uncertainty remains.
residual_risks: An unindexed same-ring path large-deviation calculation could reproduce this square-root Perron eigenvalue.
The three-spin ring is a minimal model, not an infinite-volume theorem.
Broader finite-state Markov-additive theory supplies generic methods, but a checked exact specialization matching this function was not found.

value.rationale: A natural complete long-time entropy-fluctuation invariant quantifies otherwise hidden irreversibility in a model with equilibrium Gibbs stationary marginals. The exact non-Poisson entropy-variance term measures intermittency of defect occupations, beyond merely recomputing mean rates or invoking a generic fluctuation theorem; exact three-spin minimal model is physically motivated.
